topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture series, describes the audience and scope, and establishes the learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Differentiation and Tissue Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how cancer arises from accumulated genetic changes that disrupt normal cellular differentiation programs and three-dimensional tissue architecture.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Malignant Progression
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how tumors progress from contained benign lesions into invasive and metastatic malignancies.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the standardized rules and exceptions for naming benign and malignant neoplasms according to their tissue origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the physiological mechanisms by which primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic disease and patient death.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence Across Tissues and Species
topics.groupedBecause: They survey the comparative incidence and mortality of cancer across different human organ systems and diverse animal species.

topics.label: Principles and Practice of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the clinical rationale, methodology, and varying effectiveness of screening programs for detecting early-stage cancers.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-Up and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session by reviewing the learning outcomes and reminding students about upcoming practicals.
